newsitem.title: CHINA: China orders fast repayments to JV leasing firms.
newsitem.headline: China orders fast repayments to JV leasing firms.

text.p: Five Chinese ministries and organisations issued a directive on Thursday ordering faster repayments to joint venture leasing firms in a bid to resolve a longstanding problem, the Financial News said.

The State Economic and Trade Commission, the People's Bank of China, the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation and the state-owned Bank of China issued the joint notice requiring relevant enterprises to take measures to pay back delayed leases as soon as possible.
Guarantors should also take responsibility to help enterprises to resolve their outstanding debt problems.
The circular pointed out that delayed payments to joint venture leasing firms has been a problem that has long troubled the Chinese financial leasing industry.
It said that enterprises with payment problems could apply for renminbi loans to convert their foreign currency leases into domestic renminbi currency debt.
The State Council, or cabinet, would set a quota on the amount of such loans and the Bank of China will be authorised to handle the actual implementation of the scheme, it said.
The maximum period for these loans will be for three years and the interest rate will be set at the level of fixed asset loans.
In China, most leasing involved the aircraft and shipping industries, a central bank official said by telephone.
